name: jelly-cursor
description: A jelly-like animated cursor with movement glow for VS Code.

jellyCursor.note.default: Use the command palette to install or uninstall the DOM cursor patch.
jellyCursor.note.description: This extension uses a VS Code workbench DOM patch for cursor animation.

jellyCursor.workbenchHtmlPath.markdownDescription: Full path to VS Code's `workbench.html` file. Leave empty to detect it automatically. Set this only if automatic detection fails, for example: `C:\Users\you\AppData\Local\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\resources\app\out\vs\code\electron-browser\workbench\workbench.html`

jellyCursor.reminders.description: Show reminders when the patch is missing after a VS Code update or when settings need a reinstall.

jellyCursor.statusBar.description: Show the Jelly Cursor patch status in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Full jelly deformation and movement glow.
Smooth cursor movement without jelly deformation.
No animation; the rendered cursor snaps to the native cursor.
jellyCursor.animationMode.description: Animation style for the rendered cursor.

jellyCursor.maxJumpAnimationDistance.description: Maximum jump distance in pixels animated from the previous position. Set to 0 to keep the full jump animation.

enumDescriptions: Jelly motion only, no extra effects.
Strong neon glow, short trail, springs, ripples and sparks.
Rainbow gradient glow with a long aurora trail.
Long comet tail with maximum sparks and springy motion.
jellyCursor.effectPreset.description: One-click visual preset. Selecting anything other than custom overrides the matching individual effect settings.

enumDescriptions: Render the cursor as a rounded capsule.

jellyCursor.trailEnabled.description: Draw fading afterimages behind the moving cursor.

jellyCursor.trailOpacity.description: Maximum opacity of the trail afterimages.

jellyCursor.springEnabled.description: Use spring physics so the cursor slightly overshoots and wobbles on arrival.

jellyCursor.springDamping.description: Spring damping. Lower values wobble longer.

jellyCursor.rainbowEnabled.description: Cycle the cursor and glow colors through a rainbow hue.

jellyCursor.gradientEnabled.description: Fill the cursor with a vertical gradient instead of a flat color.

jellyCursor.rippleEnabled.description: Spawn a ripple ring when clicking inside the editor.

jellyCursor.landingPulseEnabled.description: Spawn a pulse ring when the cursor lands after a jump.

jellyCursor.sparkEnabled.description: Emit small light particles while the cursor moves quickly.

jellyCursor.sparkAmount.description: How many spark particles are emitted while moving quickly.

jellyCursor.fastSpeed.description: Speed for the cursor corner closest to the movement direction.

jellyCursor.midSpeed.description: Speed for side corners of the jelly cursor.

jellyCursor.slowSpeed.description: Speed for the cursor corner opposite the movement direction.

jellyCursor.axisBias.description: How strongly horizontal or vertical movement affects corner speed selection.

jellyCursor.twistBoost.description: Extra directional deformation strength while the cursor is moving.

jellyCursor.minAlpha.description: Minimum alpha for the rendered cursor while the native cursor is blinking.

jellyCursor.cursorColor.description: Rendered cursor color. Leave empty to follow the native VS Code cursor color.

jellyCursor.glowColor.description: Cursor glow color. Leave empty to follow the rendered cursor color.

jellyCursor.glowOpacity.description: Maximum glow opacity while the cursor is moving.

jellyCursor.glowIntensity.description: Glow brightness multiplier while the cursor is moving.

jellyCursor.glowSize.description: Glow size around the cursor in pixels.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
